info.title: API Watch
info.description: Secure, observation-based website and REST API monitoring. Browser sessions use CSRF protection; personal API tokens use Bearer authentication. External target errors are check outcomes, not errors of this API.

503.description: Database or migration is not ready.

token.title: Token
token.description: New target credential. Omit only when an existing Bearer token is configured.

BearerAuthPatch.title: BearerAuthPatch
BearerAuthPatch.description: Omitting token preserves an existing Bearer token; enabling Bearer requires a value.

json.title: Json
json.description: Arbitrary JSON value. Numeric literals retain their original precision.

BodyRead.title: BodyRead
BodyRead.description: Disabled means no body; enabled with JSON null means a literal null body.

http_status.title: Http Status
http_status.description: Observed target status; null if no HTTP response was received.

response_time_ms.title: Response Time Ms
response_time_ms.description: Full HTTP exchange duration; null when the exchange did not complete.

failed_assertions.title: Failed Assertions
failed_assertions.description: Zero-based indices of failed JSON assertions.

CheckRead.title: CheckRead
CheckRead.description: A logical check. Queued and running checks have no terminal outcome.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty selects the root; ~0 escapes ~ and ~1 escapes /.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Required JSON value, including explicit null. Numbers retain exact precision.

EqualsAssertion.title: EqualsAssertion
EqualsAssertion.description: The pointer must resolve and equal the supplied, type-sensitive JSON value.

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope
ErrorEnvelope.description: Shared safe error format for validation, authorization, and dependency failures.

pointer.title: Pointer
pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty selects the root; ~0 escapes ~ and ~1 escapes /.

ExistsAssertion.title: ExistsAssertion
ExistsAssertion.description: The pointer must resolve; an existing JSON null satisfies this assertion.

HealthLiveRead.title: HealthLiveRead
HealthLiveRead.description: Liveness checks only the API process and never contact monitored targets.

HealthReadyRead.title: HealthReadyRead
HealthReadyRead.description: Readiness reports database/migration readiness separately from worker health.

IncidentRead.title: IncidentRead
IncidentRead.description: Confirmed incident timeline; an aborted incident does not imply recovery.

MonitorPatch.title: MonitorPatch
MonitorPatch.description:
Partial atomic update. Omitted fields are preserved; only the latency limit accepts null.

Request execution fields require an idle paused monitor. Public header,
parameter, assertion, and body values replace their corresponding settings.
Secret headers are operations, not an array replacement. MISSING keeps the
omission/null distinction both at runtime and in the generated OpenAPI schema.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Read-only reflection of whether state is active.

busy.title: Busy
busy.description: A check is queued or running for this monitor.

MonitorRead.title: MonitorRead
MonitorRead.description: Current settings and scheduled health, with write-only credentials removed.

NoAuthRequest.title: NoAuthRequest
NoAuthRequest.description: Switching to none deletes the saved built-in Bearer token.

NotificationRead.title: NotificationRead
NotificationRead.description: Delivery metadata; no Telegram chat identifier or message credentials.

PublicHeader.title: PublicHeader

QueryParameter.title: QueryParameter

SecretHeaderRead.title: SecretHeaderRead
SecretHeaderRead.description: Presence marker for an encrypted header; its value is never returned.

SecretHeaderRemove.description: Delete an encrypted header by its case-insensitive name.

healthy.title: Healthy

ServiceProcessRead.description: One authenticated background-process heartbeat without infrastructure secrets.

StatsRead.title: StatsRead
StatsRead.description: Metrics over [from, to), with all contributing configuration versions.

token.title: Token

TokenCreatedRead.description: Token creation adds its secret exactly once; store it before closing the response.

UserRead.title: UserRead
